notes: x86-64 Linux, NASM syntax, no libc: only the write, mmap, munmap and exit syscalls.
No allocator exists, so 16-byte nodes are carved with a bump pointer from mmap'd arenas sized for exactly one tree (2^(d+1) − 1 nodes).
Short-lived trees are released by resetting the bump pointer before the next tree (the stretch tree by munmap); the long-lived tree has its own arena.
Recursive build and check via call/ret (depth ≤ 22); the whole output (< 1 KiB) goes out in one write.
